summary: ObjectGenome.inspect currently accepts familyId/variantKey values longer than 512 bytes because isSemanticKey has no byte bound, but ObjectGenome.identityKey then passes those validated fields into StableId.fromParts, whose deterministic contract asserts each semantic part is <=512 bytes. This creates a validation-success/identity-crash boundary on canonical ObjectGenome data. Primary should make inspect reject over-limit identity semantic parts (while preserving the 512-byte boundary) and tests should lock the behavior.
evidence: src/shared/Objects/ObjectGenome.luau isSemanticKey only checks lowercase semantic syntax and does not bound byte length.
ObjectGenome.identityParts includes familyId and variantKey, and identityKey validates then calls StableId.fromParts.
src/shared/Core/DeterminismContract.luau stableId asserts every semantic part is <=512 bytes.
